name: Stripe for Agents (Stripe AI)
summary: Stripe's agent toolkit: plugins, remote MCP, agent skills and SDKs for usage-based billing, agentic commerce and machine payments.
description: The stripe/ai repo (formerly stripe/agent-toolkit) includes `@stripe/ai-sdk` and `@stripe/token-meter` for billing LLM usage, official plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others, and skills installable with `npx skills add https://docs.stripe.com`.
